title: Pubspec with an unconstrained SDK range
description: pubspec.yaml declares an `environment.sdk` value of `any`. The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads an `environment.sdk` value of `any`.
remediation: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix an `environment.sdk` value of `any`.
limitation: It matches an `environment.sdk` value of `any` in the parsed pubspec.yaml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
